subject: s4 (after low_rim_off), eyes_s4.png
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, male protagonist

outline_shape.reference: a flat gentle upper arch peaking a little toward the inner side, a deep rounded U-shaped lower lid, a blunt rounded inner corner and a softly pointed outer corner sitting a little lower than the inner corner
outline_shape.ours: a flat gentle upper arch peaking a little toward the inner side, a deep rounded U-shaped lower lid, a blunt rounded inner corner and a softly pointed outer corner sitting a little lower than the inner corner; smooth curves

height_to_width.reference: the eye including the lid line is 0.58 as tall as it is wide (measured)
height_to_width.ours: the eye including the lid line is 0.63 as tall as it is wide (measured)

eye_size.reference: the eye width is 0.77 of the distance from the eye centre down to the bottom of the nose (measured on the near eye)
eye_size.ours: the eye width is 0.70 of the distance from the eye centre down to the bottom of the nose (measured, front view)

eye_spacing.reference: the gap between the eyes is a little more than one eye width (the frame is a 3/4 view, so it can only be estimated)
eye_spacing.ours: the gap between the inner corners is 1.08 eye widths (measured, front view)

iris_size.reference: a tall oval iris 0.45 of the eye width wide; its bottom is just above the lower lid and its top is cut by the upper lid line
iris_size.ours: a tall oval iris 0.45 of the eye width wide; its bottom is just above the lower lid and its top is cut by the upper lid line

iris_colour.reference: medium green, slightly darker at the top, with a light mint crescent filling the lower part of the iris
iris_colour.ours: medium green, slightly darker at the top, with a light mint crescent filling the lower part of the iris

iris_pattern.reference: two dark concentric arcs on the nose side of the pupil and one on the outer side, about as thick as the iris outline, plus a dark outline around the iris
iris_pattern.ours: two dark concentric arcs on the nose side of the pupil and one on the outer side, about as thick as the iris outline, plus a dark outline around the iris

pupil.reference: a dark vertical oval, about a quarter of the iris width, a little above the iris centre
pupil.ours: a dark vertical oval, about a quarter of the iris width, a little above the iris centre

highlight.reference: one white horizontal oval at mid height on the iris edge, overlapping the white; it sits on the viewer's left side of the iris in BOTH eyes (one light direction)
highlight.ours: one white horizontal oval at mid height on the iris edge, overlapping the white; it sits on the viewer's left side of the iris in both eyes (one light direction)

sclera.reference: warm light grey, with a neutral grey band under the upper lid line about a quarter of the eye height
sclera.ours: warm light grey, with a neutral grey band under the upper lid line about a quarter of the eye height

upper_lid_line.reference: a dark brown line of fairly even thickness, about 0.08 of the eye width, thinner at the inner corner, running into the outer corner and a short way down along the lower lid
upper_lid_line.ours: a dark brown line of fairly even thickness, about 0.08 of the eye width, thinner at the inner corner, running into the outer corner and a short way down along the lower lid; two thin skin-coloured slivers show inside the line at the outer corner

lower_lid_line.reference: no dark line along the lower lid; the white meets the skin with only a faint warm-grey edge
lower_lid_line.ours: no line along the lower lid; the white meets the skin directly

brow_shape.reference: one brush stroke with a pointed inner tip cut on a steep diagonal, 0.25 of the eye width thick (with its shadow) 0.2 eye widths from the tip and 0.13 thick over the middle of the eye, tapering to a point; 1.53 eye widths long, starting 0.33 eye widths on the nose side of the inner corner and ending 0.22 eye widths past the outer corner; nearly straight, rising outward; fine diagonal brush strokes
brow_shape.ours: one brush stroke with a pointed inner tip cut on a steep diagonal, 0.11 of the eye width thick 0.2 eye widths from the tip and 0.12 thick over the middle of the eye, tapering to a point; about 1.50 eye widths long, starting 0.34 eye widths on the nose side of the inner corner and ending 0.16 eye widths past the outer corner; nearly straight, rising outward; steep diagonal brush strokes

brow_position.reference: at the middle of the eye the gap between the brow and the lid line is 0.14 of the eye height; the inner tip sits level with the top of the eye's inner corner; the outer end is 0.88 eye heights above the outer corner
brow_position.ours: at the middle of the eye the gap between the brow and the lid line is 0.14 of the eye height; the inner tip sits level with the top of the eye's inner corner; the outer end is about 0.8 eye heights above the outer corner

brow_colour.reference: a greyish medium brown averaging (118, 88, 65) sRGB with darker brown brush strokes, and a mauve shadow under the inner end, detached slightly below it
brow_colour.ours: a greyish medium brown averaging (121, 94, 70) sRGB with darker brown diagonal brush strokes, and a pinkish-mauve shadow under the inner end

flatness.reference: the eye reads as flat paint on the skin with no depth or socket
flatness.ours: the eye reads as flat paint on the skin with no depth or socket
